hunks.baseline: As its name suggested, a fast ship was built with speed as its top priority.
hunks.sol: As its name suggested, a swift ship was built with speed as its top priority.

hunks.baseline: If an ordinary warship was a heavyweight in terms of size, then a fast ship was something closer to a welterweight.
hunks.sol: If an ordinary warship was a heavyweight, then a swift ship was closer to a welterweight.

hunks.baseline: As a result, the ship’s hull wasn’t particularly large. Which meant there weren’t many places to hide from everyone else.
hunks.sol: Naturally, its hull wasn’t particularly large, which meant there weren’t many places aboard where you could avoid everyone else’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: Two river bandits who had been slacking off at the stern under the pretense of standing guard recognized me and bowed deeply.
hunks.sol: Two river bandits who had been slacking off at the stern under the pretense of standing guard recognized me and bowed obsequiously.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, something sharp poked me right in the Mingmen acupoint at the small of my back.
hunks.sol: At that moment, something sharp poked the Mingmen acupoint at the small of my back.

hunks.baseline: I continued speaking while shooting an urgent sidelong glance at Mungyeong, who was pressed tightly against my side with his needle at my back.
hunks.sol: I continued speaking while shooting an urgent sidelong glance at Mungyeong, who was pressed against my side.

hunks.baseline: “Be sure to take care on your way! If anyone asks about me, tell them I’m with Mungyeong!”
hunks.sol: “Be sure to watch yourselves! If anyone asks about me, tell them I’m with Mungyeong!”

hunks.baseline: “No, not ‘understood.’ Say, right! My master! If my master comes looking for me…”
hunks.sol: “No, not ‘understood.’ Oh, right! My master! If my master comes looking for me…”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong cut me off with a clear smile.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong cut me off with an innocent smile.

hunks.baseline: “Your Master seemed to have something important to discuss with Great Hero Jin Wikyung. In any case, we’ve only come to see a patient for a moment, so please don’t concern yourself with us. Go on and rest in the cabin. I’ll let you know afterward.”
hunks.sol: “Your Master seemed to have something important to discuss with Great Hero Jin Wikyung. In any case, we only came here for a brief examination, so please don’t concern yourselves with us. Go rest in the cabin. I’ll let you know when we’re finished.”

hunks.baseline: “Then that works for us.”
hunks.sol: “Works for us.”

hunks.baseline: There was nothing sweeter than legally slacking off in the middle of a boring guard shift.
hunks.sol: Nothing was sweeter than authorized slacking in the middle of a boring guard shift.

hunks.baseline: The river bandits, now free to enjoy the shade, smiled and left. The Sound Transmission I had been preparing to send as my last hope was blocked by a single sentence from Mungyeong.
hunks.sol: The river bandits smiled and left, delighted to lounge in the cool shade. As for the Sound Transmission I was preparing to send as a last resort, a single sentence from Mungyeong stopped me cold.

hunks.baseline: “You seem to have three or four lives.”
hunks.sol: “You must have three or four lives to spare.”

hunks.baseline: “You have two choices. Answer every question this old man asks from now on, or quietly keep your mouth shut if you don’t want to.”
hunks.sol: “You have two choices. Answer every question this old man asks from now on, or, if you’d rather not, quietly keep your mouth shut.”

hunks.baseline: Just as I was about to answer, Mungyeong calmly continued.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong calmly continued before I could finish.

hunks.baseline: “You’ll drift all the way to Hubei while sunk at the bottom of the Yangtze. Quietly.”
hunks.sol: “You’ll drift all the way there along the bottom of the Yangtze. Quietly.”

hunks.baseline: “…I thought you said you had given up killing.”
hunks.sol: “…I thought you said you’d stopped killing.”

hunks.baseline: *What the fuck? It isn’t like he’s quitting smoking…*
hunks.sol: *What the fuck? It isn’t like he’s trying to quit smoking…*

hunks.baseline: Unable to believe what I was hearing, I challenged him again.
hunks.sol: Dumbfounded, I protested again.

hunks.baseline: “I’m the former Divine Physician. I passed that name on to my Disciple long ago. So? What’s your answer?”
hunks.sol: “The former Divine Physician. I passed that name on to my Disciple long ago. So? What’s your answer?”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong seemed to have lost his words for a moment. After a long silence, he finally spoke.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong seemed momentarily at a loss for words. After a long silence, he finally spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve met all kinds of strange men, but you’re something else.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve seen all kinds, but never anyone as strange as you.”

hunks.baseline: “From everyone else’s perspective, I’d say we’re no different. Send a messenger-pigeon survey to all of Murim and ask which one of us is the bigger freak.”
hunks.sol: “From everyone else’s perspective, I’d say we’re both equally strange. Send a messenger-pigeon survey to everyone in Murim and ask which one of us is the bigger freak.”

hunks.baseline: He silently stared at me as I swallowed hard, then tossed out a single word.
hunks.sol: He silently watched me swallow hard, then tossed out a single phrase.

hunks.baseline: “Until a few days ago—no, until half a day ago—your Middle Dantian was closed. What trick did you pull to accomplish such a great feat overnight?”
hunks.sol: “Until a few days ago—no, until half a day ago—your Middle Dantian was closed. What trick did you use to accomplish such a great feat overnight?”

hunks.baseline: *So this was why he had called me aside.*
hunks.sol: *So this was why he’d called me aside.*

hunks.baseline: *I knew he had noticed.*
hunks.sol: *I knew he’d noticed.*

hunks.baseline: Martial realms were arranged in a perfect vertical structure.
hunks.sol: The hierarchy of martial realms was perfectly vertical.

hunks.baseline: It was like sitting at a high point and looking down at every landscape beneath you.
hunks.sol: It was like sitting in a lofty place and looking down upon everything beneath you.

hunks.baseline: The Fire King and the Slaughter Saint were extraordinary powerhouses who had climbed to the highest peaks in the rugged mountain range known as Murim.
hunks.sol: The Fire King and the Slaughter Saint were peerless masters who had climbed the highest peaks in the rugged mountain range known as Murim.

hunks.baseline: They had opened their Middle Dantians long before a person named Jin Taekyung had even been born. Naturally, they had noticed my change.
hunks.sol: Both had opened their Middle Dantians long before a person named Jin Taekyung had even been born into Murim. Of course they had noticed the change in me.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t as though I had farted in my sleep and somehow opened my Middle Dantian. Other people could only gain that kind of enlightenment through blood-soaked training or extreme situations where they hovered between life and death.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t as though I had farted in my sleep and somehow opened my Middle Dantian. Other people could attain that kind of enlightenment only through grueling, blood-soaked training or while hovering between life and death.

hunks.baseline: I hesitated for a moment, then spotted the large acupuncture needle in Mungyeong’s hand and answered quickly.
hunks.sol: I hesitated, then spotted the large acupuncture needle in Mungyeong’s hand and hurriedly answered.

hunks.baseline: “Are you telling me to believe that?”
hunks.sol: “…And you expect me to believe that?”

hunks.baseline: So I inserted a cliché commonly found in martial arts novels.
hunks.sol: So I threw in a cliché straight out of a martial arts novel.

hunks.baseline: I lowered my voice and glanced around us. Mungyeong’s brow furrowed.
hunks.sol: I glanced around and lowered my voice. Mungyeong’s brow furrowed.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. A white-haired old man who looked incredibly ancient suddenly started swinging a sword at me without warning. At the time, I didn’t even realize it was a dream, so I just focused on dodging.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. A white-haired old man who looked incredibly ancient suddenly started swinging a sword at me without warning. I didn’t even realize it was a dream, so I focused on dodging first.”

hunks.baseline: It didn’t matter whether it had been a spear, a sword, or a back-scratcher. This was a world where all kinds of superstition ran rampant.
hunks.sol: It didn’t matter whether it was a spear, a sword, or a back-scratcher. This was a world overrun with all kinds of superstition.

hunks.baseline: The appearance of a white-haired old man with the air of an immortal was interesting enough to pique anyone’s curiosity.
hunks.sol: A white-haired old man with the air of an immortal appearing in my dream was enough to pique anyone’s curiosity.

hunks.baseline: Sure enough, Mungyeong asked with an expression like a webnovel reader waiting for the next update,
hunks.sol: Sure enough, Mungyeong asked with the eager expression of a webnovel reader waiting for the next update.

hunks.baseline: “I summoned every last ounce of strength I had and fought back, but I couldn’t even come close to matching him. No matter what attack I used, he dodged it without a care. And whenever I tried to get away, he would glide up to me like a ghost and slash me with his sword. Swish, slash—ugh! You know the feeling?”
hunks.sol: “I summoned every last ounce of strength I had and fought back, but I was no match for him. No matter how I attacked, he dodged without a care. And whenever I tried to get away, he glided up to me like a ghost and slashed me with his sword. Swish, slash—ugh! You know what I mean?”

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t have time to realize anything. Besides, the pain was incredibly vivid. I was cut hundreds of times in an instant and thought, *So this is how I die.* But not a single drop of blood came out. That was when I realized it was a dream.”
hunks.sol: “I didn’t have time to realize anything. Besides, the pain felt incredibly real. Before I knew it, he’d cut me hundreds of times. I thought, *So this is how I die.* But then I noticed I hadn’t shed a single drop of blood. That was when I realized it was a dream.”

hunks.baseline: “But it was driving me insane. I kept getting cut by that sword, and it hurt like hell. Even after I realized it was a dream, I couldn’t wake up.”
hunks.sol: “But it was driving me insane. He kept cutting me, and it hurt like hell. Even after I realized it was a dream, I couldn’t wake up.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Exactly.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Naturally.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong flinched as if he had been cut himself.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong flinched as if he’d been cut himself.

hunks.baseline: *This guy has surprisingly good reactions.*
hunks.sol: *This guy gives surprisingly good reactions.*

hunks.baseline: Having confirmed the instinct of the webnovel reader hiding behind the terrifying name of Slaughter Saint, I continued without hesitation.
hunks.sol: Having reconfirmed the instincts of the webnovel reader hidden behind the terrifying name of Slaughter Saint, I continued without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t even know how much time passed. Days? Months? I lost all sense of time as I was cut countless times and kept swinging back. Then, all of a sudden, a strange sensation came over me.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t even know how much time passed. Days? Months? I lost all sense of time as he cut me over and over and I kept swinging back. Then, all of a sudden, I felt something strange.”

hunks.baseline: This part, at least, I could describe in detail and tell him the truth. It was something I had personally experienced in my battle with the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: This part, at least, I could describe in detail and tell him the truth. It was something I had personally experienced during my battle with the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong heard my explanation—one that an ordinary person might have dismissed as some vague, airy description—and muttered quietly.
hunks.sol: An ordinary person might have dismissed my explanation as vague, airy nonsense, but after listening, Mungyeong quietly muttered, “Enlightenment. You gained a fortuitous encounter.”

hunks.baseline: “Enlightenment. You gained a fortuitous encounter.”

hunks.baseline: “Wow, I’ve got goose bumps. He said something similar.”
hunks.sol: “Whoa, I’ve got goose bumps. He said something similar.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. He looked at me and smiled for the first time, then said that this fortuitous encounter was a blessing he was giving me and that I should devote myself to my training even more.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. He looked at me and smiled for the first time, then said that this fortuitous encounter was a blessing he was bestowing upon me and that I should devote myself even more fully to my training.”

hunks.baseline: I had come up with the story by squeezing my brain dry in a short amount of time. I had already used up everything I’d prepared.
hunks.sol: I’d squeezed this entire story out of my brain on the spot, and I’d already used everything I had prepared.

hunks.baseline: But Mungyeong was demanding another installment, and I had no material left in reserve.
hunks.sol: But Mungyeong was demanding another installment, and I had nothing left in reserve.

hunks.baseline: The problem was that Mungyeong wasn’t an ordinary reader.
hunks.sol: The problem was, Mungyeong wasn’t an ordinary reader.

hunks.baseline: What would happen? I’d sink to the bottom of the Yangtze and drift all the way to Hubei.
hunks.sol: What else? I’d sink to the bottom of the Yangtze and drift all the way to Hubei.

hunks.baseline: Under Mungyeong’s narrowing gaze, I hurriedly opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: As Mungyeong’s eyes narrowed, I hurriedly opened my mouth.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed dryly and cautiously spoke.
hunks.sol: I swallowed hard and spoke cautiously.

hunks.baseline: “You have to suffer to be a Murim man.”
hunks.sol: “Pain makes the martial artist.”

hunks.baseline: “He really said that. He said exactly that, then climbed onto his sword and flew away…”
hunks.sol: “He really said that. Those exact words. Then he climbed onto his sword and flew off…”

hunks.baseline: “I can sense profound wisdom.”
hunks.sol: “I can sense profound wisdom in those words.”

hunks.baseline: I let out a stupid sound while keeping a wary eye on the large needle in Mungyeong’s hand.
hunks.sol: I let out a stupefied sound while keeping a wary eye on the large needle in Mungyeong’s hand.

hunks.baseline: When I raised my head, I saw Mungyeong murmuring under his breath and nodding slightly as though he were groaning.
hunks.sol: When I raised my head, I found Mungyeong murmuring under his breath and nodding slowly.

hunks.baseline: I might not have known Lü Yan, but I knew Sword Immortal Lü Dongbin. Along with Jang Samfeng of Wudang and the Shaolin Temple’s Bodhidharma, he was one of the three perennial fixtures of martial arts novels.
hunks.sol: I might not have known Lü Yan, but I knew Sword Immortal Lü Dongbin. Along with Jang Samfeng of Wudang and Bodhidharma of Shaolin Temple, he was one of the three perennial fixtures of martial arts novels.

hunks.baseline: “The old man you saw in your dream must have been Lü Dongbin. He vanished using sword-riding sorcery at the end, so he must have been the Sword Immortal.”
hunks.sol: “The old man you saw in your dream must have been Lü Dongbin. He vanished by riding his sword at the end, so he must have been the Sword Immortal.”

hunks.baseline: I had only made it up because it sounded cooler, but somehow it had turned into this.
hunks.sol: I’d only made that part up because it sounded cool, but somehow it had turned into this.

hunks.baseline: I knew from novels that there was an immortal named Lü Dongbin, but this was the first time I had heard that he was a master of sword-riding sorcery.
hunks.sol: I knew from novels that there was an immortal named Lü Dongbin, but this was the first I’d heard of him being a master of sword-riding arts.

hunks.baseline: *If you hang it on your nose, it becomes a nose ring; if you hang it on your ear, it becomes an earring.*
hunks.sol: *Talk about making the facts fit the theory.*

hunks.baseline: That was exactly the situation I was in.
hunks.sol: That was exactly what was happening.

hunks.baseline: Having decided that the old man in my dream—or rather, the old man in my story—was Lü Dongbin, Mungyeong was fitting everything together with absolute seriousness without even realizing it.
hunks.sol: Having decided that the old man from my dream—or rather, my story—was Lü Dongbin, Mungyeong was now fitting everything together with absolute seriousness without even realizing it.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, he was just short. I was being cut to pieces the whole time. When would I have had the chance to look at something like that?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, just short. I was being cut to pieces the entire time. When was I supposed to study his height?”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong nodded and let most of it pass, but there was one dangerously close call.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong nodded and let most of my answers pass, but there was one dangerously close call.

hunks.baseline: “What was it… His scabbard.”
hunks.sol: “Let me think… His scabbard.”

hunks.baseline: “…I think that was all.”
hunks.sol: “…I don’t think so.”

hunks.baseline: The light in Mungyeong’s eyes sank deep.
hunks.sol: The light in Mungyeong’s eyes darkened.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea why a man known as the Sword Immortal would walk around carrying a fly-whisk, but my top priority was avoiding Mungyeong’s suspicions. Without letting a single change cross my face, I answered.
hunks.sol: I had no idea why a man known as the Sword Immortal would walk around carrying a fly-whisk, but my top priority was avoiding Mungyeong’s suspicion. Without so much as blinking, I answered.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck, I’m the one who saw him. What are you going to do about it?*
hunks.sol: *That’s right, fucker. I’m the one who saw him. What are you going to do about it?*

hunks.baseline: Seizing the advantage, I pressed Mungyeong hard while he was momentarily at a loss for words.
hunks.sol: Seizing the advantage, I bore down on Mungyeong while he was momentarily at a loss for words.

hunks.baseline: “And did I say he was Lü Dongbin? I thought he was just some old man. You were the one who called him Lü Dongbin first.”
hunks.sol: “And did I ever say he was Lü Dongbin? I thought he was just some old man. You were the one who called him Lü Dongbin first.”

hunks.baseline: “That isn’t the point. That’s what happened, isn’t it? Honestly, I don’t care whether he was Lü Dongbin or Kim Dongbin. I met some unidentified old man in a dream and gained a fortuitous encounter. That’s all. But you’re hounding me like I’ve committed some terrible crime, so I really…”
hunks.sol: “That isn’t the point. That’s what happened, isn’t it? Honestly, I don’t care whether he was Lü Dongbin or Kim Dongbin. I met some unidentified old man in a dream and gained a fortuitous encounter. That’s all. But you’re hounding me like I’ve committed some terrible crime, so I really… Ha.”

hunks.baseline: “Can you see the tears in my eyes? I really don’t want to do this as a man, but I’m so wronged that I’m actually crying.”
hunks.sol: “Can you see the tears in my eyes? I don’t want to act like this as a grown man, but this is so unfair I’m actually crying.”

hunks.baseline: The self-loathing over having to invent lies while being threatened like this—despite having committed no crime—only made things worse. Before long, another tear rolled down my cheek.
hunks.sol: That, combined with the self-loathing of having to invent lies under threat despite committing no crime, eventually sent a tear rolling down my cheek.

hunks.baseline: I had wet myself below earlier, and now I was wetting myself above.
hunks.sol: First I’d leaked from the bottom, and now I was leaking from the top.

hunks.baseline: I had started all this as an act, but it had somehow become real. For the first time, bewilderment crossed Mungyeong’s nearly expressionless face.
hunks.sol: It had started as an act, but somehow it had become real. Bewilderment flashed across Mungyeong’s nearly expressionless face.

hunks.baseline: “Ugh, you’re doing it again. I’m done. I quit. I answered everything, so I’m leaving.”
hunks.sol: “Ugh, there you go again. I’m done. I quit. I answered all your questions, so I’m leaving.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t care. Do whatever you want. Kill me, spare me, use Impure World Reincarnation[^2] on me—whatever.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t care anymore. Do whatever you want. Kill me, spare me, use Impure World Reincarnation[^2] on me—whatever.”

hunks.baseline: Just as I was about to take a step, someone appeared while scattering a powerful aura.
hunks.sol: Just as I was about to walk away, someone appeared, radiating an immense aura.

hunks.baseline: “What the hell is this dogshit?”
hunks.sol: “What the fuck do you think you’re doing?”
